players.product: VHM custom DRAM 3D-stacked onto the SoC via wafer-on-wafer (WoW), plus S-SiCap stacked silicon capacitors and silicon-capacitor interposers for AI/HPC advanced packages

quarterly_data.quarter: AP Memory press release: AP Memory Completed GDR Pricing, Strengthening Future (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 revenue reached a record high of NT$1.19 billion, up 15% MoM and 90% YoY (stated in the company's GDR-pricing release). The company attributes its revenue growth to the supply shortage of IoTRAM and the production ramp of S-SiCap: IoTRAM benefits from the supply shortage in standard memory, accelerating adoption of customized IoTRAM by more customers and applications; S-SiCap sees rapidly growing capacitor demand in advanced packaging driven by the sharp increase in AI/HPC chip power consumption, with IPC (interposer with S-SiCap) shipments continuing to ramp and IPD (discrete S-SiCap) in mass production since the second quarter amid a market shortage.
quarterly_data.figure: Sep 2026 revenue NT$1.19 billion (record; +15% MoM, +90% YoY)

quarterly_data.quarter: AP Memory press release: AP Memory Completed GDR Pricing, Strengthening Future (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (GDR-pricing release): with its rapid production ramp amid the market shortage, IPD is expected to provide strong revenue growth for S-SiCap; VHM, which targets AI and data-center inference applications needing ultra-high-bandwidth memory, is expected to enter mass production and contribute revenue from 2028 onward as customer product development and qualification progress. The company states a vision of a 1:1:1 revenue mix across its three key product lines (IoTRAM, S-SiCap and VHM).
quarterly_data.figure: 1:1:1 revenue mix across IoTRAM, S-SiCap and VHM (company vision); VHM revenue from 2028 onward
